create.name: Healing Spring Monastery (La Source Guérissante)
create.bio:
Healing Spring, or La Source Guérissante, is a monastery and mindfulness practice centre for monks of the Plum Village tradition of Zen Master Thich Nhat Hanh, in Verdelot in the Seine-et-Marne, east of Paris. It occupies a nineteenth-century convent that Augustinian sisters from Meaux left around 2000, set in nearly two hectares of green hillside; its name comes from a holy spring nearby with legends attached to it. A resident community of monastic brothers lives and practises there, and the sisters of Maison de l'Inspir are a short walk away, joining the brothers for some days of mindfulness and retreats.

The monastery opens on Sundays for days of mindfulness and runs residential retreats through the year, from weekends to seven-day stays and holiday retreats at Christmas and New Year, many of them taught in English and reachable by train from Paris. Its YouTube channel, running since 2019, carries recorded Dharma talks and question-and-answer sessions by the brothers, much of it in English from its hiking and educator retreats, with some teaching in French.

courses.title: Weekend Retreat at Healing Spring – Dec.1
courses.description: A residential weekend in English with the monastic community, open to beginners and experienced practitioners of all genders, with vegan meals and a shared day of mindfulness on the Sunday.

courses.title: Christmas Holiday Retreat at Healing Spring – 5 days
courses.description: Five days over Christmas living alongside the brothers and practising mindfulness in daily life, taught in English by a monastic Dharma teacher.
